words.note: 直接表示兩人之間的關係正面、健康、合作順利。
words.example: She has a good relationship with her manager.

exercises.original: She gets along with her manager and feels comfortable discussing problems with him.
exercises.zh: 她和經理關係良好，也很自在地和他討論問題。
exercises.upgrade: She has a good relationship with her manager and feels comfortable discussing problems with him.

options.explanation: 看似合理，因為良好關係中常有共識；但 discussing problems comfortably 描述的是整體關係，不是某個觀點是否一致。
句中同時有 manager 和 feels comfortable discussing problems，明確表示持續而正面的工作關係。
合作只是工作行為；兩人可以合作但關係緊張。
表示更親密的私人關係，對 manager 未必成立，程度過強。
尊重不等於互動順利。
只表示職務上下級關係，沒有說關係品質。

exercises.original: The company gets along with its major suppliers and rarely has serious disputes with them.
exercises.upgrade: The company has a good relationship with its major suppliers and rarely has serious disputes with them.

options.explanation: 可表示態度友善，但 company-supplier relationship 是持續商業關係，這個說法太偏單方面態度。
rarely has serious disputes 是長期關係良好的明確線索。
可能在合約條款上同意，但不表示整體商業關係。
供應商可能很重要，但依賴不等於相處良好。
只表示有業務往來，完全不評價關係好壞。
供應商通常不是此句中的競爭對手，而且意思不同。

exercises.original: He gets along with both of his neighbours, even though they have very different personalities.
exercises.upgrade: He has a good relationship with both of his neighbours, even though they have very different personalities.

options.explanation: 喜歡某人和實際相處順利很接近，但 relationship 更完整地描述長期互動。
even though they have very different personalities 強調雖然不同，仍能相處良好。
比原意更強，get along with 不表示一定成為親密朋友。
不同個性的人也可以對某些事意見不同，但仍相處好。
只描述地理位置。
表示依賴，不是關係品質。

words.meaning: 和……關係良好；相處無衝突
words.note: 表示和某人的關係友好、沒有敵意或明顯衝突。
words.example: He is still on good terms with his former business partner.
words.exampleZh: 他和以前的生意夥伴仍然保持良好關係。

exercises.original: She still gets along with her former business partner despite the company having closed.
exercises.zh: 公司雖然已結業，她和以前的生意夥伴仍然保持良好關係。
exercises.upgrade: She is still on good terms with her former business partner despite the company having closed.

options.explanation: former business partner + still + past shared history 是這個片語非常典型的語境，表示關係沒有惡化。
可能過度暗示私人親密。
公司結束後是否意見一致不是重點。
former 表示現在未必仍合作。
不是依賴關係。
和原句的友好關係相反。

exercises.original: After the disagreement, the two departments worked hard to get along with each other again.
exercises.upgrade: After the disagreement, the two departments worked hard to be on good terms with each other again.
exercises.answer: be on good terms with each other

options.explanation: 部門本身通常不說「成為朋友」，而且比單純恢復良好關係更私人化。

options.text: be on good terms with each other
options.explanation: after the disagreement + again 明確指修復關係、消除敵意。
關係良好不需要所有事情都同意。
相互依賴和人際／部門關係品質不同。
是組織合併，完全不同。
是匯報關係，不表示友好。

exercises.original: He gets along with his ex-colleague and occasionally meets him for coffee.
exercises.upgrade: He is on good terms with his ex-colleague and occasionally meets him for coffee.

options.explanation: ex-colleague + occasional coffee meetings 表示離職後仍保持友好關係。
沒有上下級權力線索。
偶爾見面不代表所有觀點相同。
不是親屬關係。
ex-colleague 表示過去同事，不是現在從屬。
和友好互動方向相反。

words.note: 英式英語中很常見，意思和 get along with 幾乎相同。
words.example: I get on well with most of my colleagues.
words.exampleZh: 我和大部分同事都相處得很好。

exercises.original: I get along with most people in my team.
exercises.zh: 我和團隊裡大部分人都相處得很好。
exercises.upgrade: I get on with most people in my team.

options.explanation: 這是 British English 中幾乎直接對應 get along with 的自然說法。
你不需要和所有隊員意見一致才能相處好。
表示上下級關係。
表示依賴。
表示照顧。
表示競爭，不能保留良好相處的核心意思。

exercises.original: She gets along with her flatmates because everyone respects each other's privacy.
exercises.upgrade: She gets on with her flatmates because everyone respects each other's privacy.

options.explanation: flatmates + mutual respect 是典型日常相處語境。
可能成立，但 get along with 不要求親密友情。
尊重私隱不代表意見相同。
共同生活確實需要合作，但 cooperate 太偏任務／工作。
只說同住，不說相處品質。
只是一種行為，不足以概括整體關係。

exercises.original: Do you get along with your new supervisor?
exercises.upgrade: Do you get on with your new supervisor?

options.explanation: 這個問題在問「你們相處得好不好」，和 target 完全一致。
supervisor 可能是你的上司，但這只說職務關係。
可能只問某個觀點，不是整體相處。
尊重和相處順利並不完全相同。
認識某人不表示相處好。
是匯報線，不是人際關係品質。

words.note: 表示兩人互動友好、態度親切。
words.example: She is friendly with everyone in the office.
words.exampleZh: 她和辦公室裡每個人都很友好。

exercises.original: She gets along with everyone in the office, even people from other departments.
exercises.zh: 她和辦公室裡每個人都很友好，包括其他部門的人。
exercises.upgrade: She is friendly with everyone in the office, even people from other departments.

options.explanation: everyone in the office 表示廣泛、日常的友好互動，而不一定是深入關係。
不可能自然暗示她和每個人都情感親密，程度過強。
不需要和每個同事意見一致。
表示管理關係。
只表示位置／工作環境。
表示依賴。

exercises.original: The new student quickly got along with the people sitting near her.
exercises.upgrade: The new student quickly became friendly with the people sitting near her.

options.explanation: new student + quickly 表示她很快和附近同學建立友好互動。
沒有觀點或議題作為同意對象。
親屬關係不能因坐得近而形成。
語氣過正式，而且沒有特定任務。
沒有依賴線索。
方向相反。

exercises.original: Although they are not close friends, the two neighbours get along with each other.
exercises.upgrade: Although they are not close friends, the two neighbours are friendly with each other.

options.explanation: not close friends 是 decisive clue：關係友好，但不一定親密。
直接和 not close friends 的語義形成衝突。
可能在很多事上不同意，但仍保持友好。
互相依賴不是本句重點。
沒有工作關係。
與友好相處相反。

words.note: 表示雙方很容易互相理解、交流自然，而且互動舒服。
words.example: The teacher has a good rapport with her students.
words.exampleZh: 這位老師和學生很有默契，互動融洽。

exercises.original: The teacher gets along with her students and can easily encourage them to speak in class.
exercises.zh: 老師和學生互動融洽，很容易鼓勵他們在課堂上發言。
exercises.upgrade: The teacher has a good rapport with her students and can easily encourage them to speak in class.

options.explanation: 也合理，但只表示友善；句子進一步說她能讓學生自在開口，顯示互信和溝通默契。
encourage them to speak 是關鍵線索：師生之間有自然、互信的互動。
老師不需要同意學生所有觀點。
權威關係存在，但權威不等於 rapport。
師生關係不需要私人朋友式親密，而且這個說法專業上過強。
只是教學行為，不表示關係品質。

exercises.original: The doctor gets along with nervous patients and quickly makes them feel comfortable.
exercises.upgrade: The doctor has a good rapport with nervous patients and quickly makes them feel comfortable.

options.explanation: nervous patients + makes them feel comfortable 指專業互動中建立信任、溝通順暢。
醫生和病人不需要成為私人朋友。
不是意見一致問題。
醫生確實治療病人，但 treatment 不表示 mutual communication quality。
安撫只是 rapport 的一部分，而且這不是自然平行替代表達。
不是這種醫患關係。

exercises.original: The salesperson gets along with clients because she listens carefully and understands what they need.
exercises.upgrade: The salesperson has a good rapport with clients because she listens carefully and understands what they need.

options.explanation: 也表示關係良好，但不如 rapport 精確表達「聆聽 + 理解需要」的溝通默契。
listens carefully + understands what they need 是 rapport 的核心線索。
客戶需求理解不等於所有意見一致。
可能過度私人化。
說服客戶是銷售技巧，但不等於建立良好互動。
只表示提供服務。

falseSynonyms.zh: 同意 ≠ 相處融洽 agree with someone 是對某個觀點表示同意，不代表整體關係良好。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can disagree with a colleague on a policy and still get along with them very well.

falseSynonyms.zh: 是朋友 ≠ 所有關係良好 be friends with 比 get along with 更強，通常表示真正的友情。
關係親密 ≠ 一般相處融洽 be close to 表示情感上很親近；你可以和同事相處很好但並不 close。
合作 ≠ 關係良好 兩個人可以因工作需要合作，但私人關係仍然不好。
尊重 ≠ 相處順利 尊重某人的能力不等於和他相處融洽。
喜歡 ≠ 一定相處好 你可以喜歡某人，但一起工作時仍經常有摩擦。
- relation = 關係、聯繫；也可指親屬 - relationship = 人際關係／兩者之間的關係 在描述人際互動時，relationship 通常更自然。
- relationship = 整體關係 - rapport = 溝通上的默契、互信與互動感 rapport 的範圍較窄。
